note: Rendered on /burnticker/operator and served by GET /api/burnticker/v1/operator (src/lib/burnticker/trustpack/operator.ts). Every value that starts with TODO_ is a placeholder the owner fills in; docs/burnticker/TODO-OWNER.md lists each one with its file and line. Devnet public keys are copied from the rehearsal records named in each `source` (test/burntickerTrustPack.test.ts checks every one appears there). Mainnet rows carry the addresses the owner configured on 2026-10-11; a TODO_ value is a key not configured yet; nothing here is a secret.

neverBuys.rule: None of the wallets above ever acquires a coin launched through the platform. The monitor lists every token account those wallets hold and every recent transaction in which one of them gained a platform coin.
neverBuys.rehearsalNote: On devnet the rehearsal itself traded on the curves (the keeper and the payer bought and sold test coins to prove fee routing and sell-back). Those trades are listed as explained, each with the evidence file that records it; on mainnet any acquisition is a red status line.
